errors.evidence: The description uses "两组" (two groups) to describe the two bars within each x-axis category. The more appropriate measure word for individual bars is "根" (gen). Using "组" (group) is slightly imprecise as it typically refers to a collection of items, and here each category has two distinct, individual bars (one of which is a stacked bar).
The y-axis is labeled up to 0.6. While the chart area extends slightly above this to accommodate the bar at 0.644, stating the scale goes to 0.7 is an imprecise description of the labeled axis range.
